proposals.evidence: LSI nāny ippi “I am” contains a separate pronoun and inflected verb. DEDR 5160 records Kodagu na·nï “I” and the na·-/en- oblique. DEDR 480 quotes Kodagu ir- (-ipp-, iñj-) “be in a place”; the present -ipp- and past iñj- are inflections of this verb. Ordered links preserve the source word boundary and do not treat the sentence as a single inherited stem.
